title: Upper bound on the divisorial gonality of a graph
exact_target: Does every finite connected graph admit a divisor of rank at least one whose degree is at most $\lfloor(g+3)/2\rfloor$, where $g$ is its genus?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3000087 (AMR-029-0087). CC BY 4.0.
Matthew Baker, Specialization of Linear Systems from Curves to Graphs (2007), sections 1.1, 1.3 and 3.1; Conjecture 3.10(1), pp. 12--13.
